about_the_game:
Introduction to the trial version

This game is a demo version of the strategy role-playing game "UltraGirl Alters". It includes the story at the beginning of the game, 8 playable levels, more than 10 indoor and outdoor scenes to explore, and several side quests. The total game experience lasts about 1 to 2 hours.

In the demo version, players will meet 5 unique heroines who form the virtual idol group Alters. They will command huge rubber suit beauties to fight monsters in live streaming, explore the controversial gossip events of INFI-X, a company that commands everything through algorithms, and start to build a trusting and intimate relationship with the 5 beauties...

Introduction

The internet giant INFI-X has launched the "One Thousand and One Nights" project to select virtual idols and mass-produce V-tuber groups. As an manager, your fate is closely tied to the five beautiful girls of Alters. You will face challenges such as marketing hype, fan wars, information cocoons, and stalking while helping the girls overcome the malice and troubles around them and grow into true idol legends.

It is a great honor to inform you that due to your outstanding comprehensive abilities, you have stood out from 100,000 resumes after 99 rounds of algorithmic screening and become a member of the INFI-X family! You will join the Xingcheng branch of INFI-X Company and serve as a virtual idol agent for the New Generation Special Photography Project.

"New tokusatsu" addresses the company's pain point of having a monotonous performance format in the virtual live streaming industry. By breaking down the granularity of tokusatsu works and aligning with the exciting battle scenes, the company uses its proprietary technology chain to incubate a new vertical virtual live streaming project. The company will continue to iterate based on this project, empowering the idol program matrix from the bottom up, and unlocking the second curve and ecological loop of the growth of the virtual live streaming business!

Here is an introduction to your job responsibilities:

Become a virtual idol manager and win the election

  • You will join the virtual idol team Alters as a broker to work and live with five teenage idols. You will be responsible for handling various issues encountered by Alters both online and offline, such as information leakage, cyber violence, and traffic manipulation. You will assist them in fully dedicating themselves to live streaming and winning in the fierce competition.

Guarding our members' daily life and forming a bond of favor.

  • According to the company's latest algorithm simulation, each member of Alters will also encounter their own personal problems. It is also your responsibility to take care of the daily life of the beautiful girls, help them solve their problems, and solve one by one the problems that prevent them from maximizing the efficiency of their performances. In this process, you may also gain the favor of the members of Alters.

    Note: If you cause economic and reputational losses to the company for personal reasons, the company may require you to compensate for the losses according to the contract terms.

Half-real-time strategy combat, dealing with different monster crises.

  • "New Tokusatsu" is the new generation virtual stage technology realized by the company through its own intellectual property rights. In the live broadcast, you will serve as the director, real-time commanding your idols and the realistic monsters generated by algorithms to fight. Through the members' different abilities and your outstanding strategies, you will work together to defeat the powerful enemy.

    Note: All monsters are generated by algorithms, and there will be no physical harm to the artist's body during the live broadcast.

Different characters with diverse skills showcase exciting performance effects in battle.

  • "New Tokusatsu" features three revolutionary innovations: fully animated movements, complete freedom of camera angles, and real-time special effects. The huge transformation of the tight-fitting suit during Alters' battles is the result of intelligent algorithms optimized for commercial purposes. During the tokusatsu live stream, you can capture the battles between the girl idols and monsters from a first-person perspective. The company encourages you to switch camera angles flexibly during the live stream to ensure a stunning performance of the combat scenes.

    Note: The company's audit department has imposed certain functional restrictions on the movement of the camera to comply with the live streaming management regulations.

More diverse level tasks and intense attacks and defenses await your challenge.

  • Ordinary battles can bore viewers. To increase user engagement and subscription rates, the company designed various scenarios and tasks for the live stream, ranging from straightforward monster hunting to defending against endless monster attacks, or escorting targets to designated locations while avoiding monster threats.

Free to explore the marketplace and unlock diverse side stories

  • Your working hours are based on a flexible work schedule of 40 hours per week (*), and the company's performance evaluation is highly humanized through the use of intelligent algorithms. Even on workdays, you can roam around the streets of Star City while working. We hope that you can understand the company's culture during your exploration and achieve a win-win situation between your personal potential and the company's benefits.

*: Based on the workload, we will dynamically adjust your working hours and schedule according to the results of algorithm calculations.

If you are willing to accept this job, please come to the INFI-X Human Resources Department at the company's designated time to complete the onboarding procedures...

For specific information, you can follow: Bilibili, Xiaohuake, Weibo, Douyin @未来发明工作室
